purpose: MASTER_PLAN.md 2.3 acceptance measurement 1 (artifact regression) and 2 (cadence retention) for the detrending change.
warning: Characterization cohort. Membership means a star previously detected at a known instrument-artifact epoch; it is not a planet candidate list.

selection.rule: ledger common_mode evidence with shared_epoch_btjd rounded to 4074.4 or 4080.8, intersected with cached SPOC Sector 100 light curves under data/lightkurve/batch_targets
selection.author: SPOC

note_on_the_original_14: MASTER_PLAN 2.3 refers to 14 light curves from the edge-safe work. That set was never recorded (commit 7a21bf3 names a count, not the targets) and cannot be reconstructed. This cohort is a recorded superset drawn from the same Sector 100 SPOC population, so the gate is reproducible.
